title: Businesses must reinvent their processes and workforce to scale agentic AI adoption
summary: Businesses must reinvent their processes and workforce to scale agentic AI adoption ZDNET
body: Businesses must reinvent their processes and workforce to scale agentic AI adoption ZDNET
summaryZh: ZDNET报道指出，企业若想实现智能体AI的大规模采用，必须对其现有业务流程和劳动力结构进行根本性的重塑与升级。原始信息显示：Businesses must reinvent their processes and workforce to scale agentic AI adoption ZDNET。该消息由ZDNET发布，主题为“Businesses must reinvent their processes and workforce to scale agentic AI adoption”。其重要性主要体现在：讨论了企业采纳智能体AI所需的组织结构与流程重构，对大模型工程落地具有指导意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
